name: Marleth Barleybrew
summary: At Brewnall Village, Marleth Barleybrew works to prove her family’s ale can rival Thunder Ale. The Thunderbrew clan’s hold on local beer trade frustrates her, and she seeks to put Barleybrew brew before drinkers.

sections.title: The Brewing Rivalry
sections.body: In Dun Morogh, beer matters as much as steel, and the Barleybrew and Thunderbrew rivalry is legendary. Ragnar Thunderbrew and his kin control nearly all the beer trade from their Kharanos distillery. Marleth Barleybrew believes her family’s brew is just as strong, but she will not challenge the Thunderbrews openly. Instead, she recruits travelers to secretly replace Kharanos tavern casks with Barleybrew kegs.

faq.answer: Marleth Barleybrew is a dwarf brewmaster at Brewnall Village in western Dun Morogh. She represents the Barleybrew family and challenges the Thunderbrew family’s hold on the local beer trade.

faq.q: Where can I find Marleth Barleybrew?
faq.answer: You can find Marleth Barleybrew in Brewnall Village, in western Dun Morogh near Iceflow Lake.

faq.q: Why does Marleth want to swap Thunderbrew's beer?
faq.answer: Marleth believes her family’s ale is as good as, or better than, Thunder Ale. The Thunderbrews dominate Kharanos’s beer trade, so she hires travelers to secretly replace the tavern’s kegs with Barleybrew stock and bring back a sample of Thunder Ale for her to study.

faq.q: Who are the other members of the Barleybrew family?
faq.answer: Marleth’s extended clan includes the brewers and tradesmen Malgin, Rejold, Wellart, and Yorus Barleybrew. They are all devoted to traditional dwarven brewing.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know brewing is an art tied to clan prestige. Marleth’s feud with the Thunderbrews is a matter of fierce family pride.
